description: Recover a project after a crash: list the copies in its Auto-Save folder (the Auto Save scratch disk, by default "Adobe Premiere Pro Auto-Save" beside the project), newest first, and with open: true open the newest (or a chosen one) as a separate project, with Premiere Pro's dialogs turned off. The original project file is not changed

folder.description: Absolute path of the Auto-Save folder, when it is not the project's

limit.description: List at most this many copies. Default 20

open.description: Open a copy: the newest, or openFile. Default false

openFile.description: With open: the copy to open, from the list

project.description: Absolute path of the project (.prproj) to recover. Default: the active project

name: recover_project
title: Recover Project
